_metadata.rules: x01 expansion drafting rules (owner style examples, one-word hints, NYC-style abbreviation exception)

clues.wordAConnection: Apollo 11's lunar module was named Eagle
clues.wordBConnection: The Apollo missions landed people on the Moon
clues.revealExplanation: "The Eagle has landed": Apollo 11's lunar module was called Eagle.

clues.wordBConnection: Moles live their lives under the cover of soil
clues.revealExplanation: A secret agent goes undercover; a mole lives under cover, literally underground.

clues.wordAConnection: In Aesop's fable the fox calls the grapes he can't reach sour
clues.wordBConnection: Sour grapes
clues.revealExplanation: Aesop's fox couldn't reach the grapes, so he decided they were sour anyway.

clues.wordAConnection: The fox is the star of 'The Fox and the Grapes'
clues.wordBConnection: The grapes are the prize in that same fable
clues.revealExplanation: 'The Fox and the Grapes' is one of Aesop's best-known fables.

clues.wordAConnection: Leonardo da Vinci painted the Mona Lisa
clues.wordBConnection: Leonardo is the blue-masked Ninja Turtle
clues.revealExplanation: The Ninja Turtles were named after Renaissance artists; Leonardo painted the Mona Lisa.

clues.wordAConnection: Michelangelo painted the Sistine Chapel ceiling
clues.wordBConnection: Michelangelo is the orange-masked Ninja Turtle
clues.revealExplanation: Michelangelo painted the Sistine Chapel ceiling, and a pizza-loving turtle borrowed his name.

clues.wordBConnection: Scorpions have pincers up front and a stinger behind
clues.revealExplanation: Crabs and scorpions both come armed with a pair of pincers.

clues.wordBConnection: Scorpio's symbol is the scorpion
clues.revealExplanation: Both are star-sign animals: the crab for Cancer and the scorpion for Scorpio.

clues.wordBConnection: Santa Claus
clues.revealExplanation: Santa Claus sounds like Santa claws.

clues.wordAConnection: Bones store most of the body's calcium
clues.wordBConnection: Milk is a famous source of calcium
clues.revealExplanation: Milk is rich in calcium, and your bones hold most of your body's calcium.

clues.wordAConnection: Fish swim together in a school
clues.wordBConnection: Pupils go to school
clues.revealExplanation: Pupils go to school, and fish swim around in one.

clues.wordAConnection: A chick peeps, and Peeps candies are shaped like chicks
clues.wordBConnection: Marshmallow Peeps are an Easter-basket staple
clues.revealExplanation: Chicks peep, and chick-shaped Peeps marshmallows show up every Easter.

clues.wordBConnection: Bambi's best friend Thumper is a rabbit
clues.revealExplanation: In Disney's Bambi, his mother is a doe and his pal Thumper is a rabbit.

clues.wordBConnection: King Kong, the giant ape on the Empire State Building
clues.revealExplanation: Donkey Kong and King Kong: two famous apes, one last name.

clues.wordAConnection: The Three Billy Goats Gruff need to cross a bridge
clues.wordBConnection: A troll lives under that bridge
clues.revealExplanation: In 'Three Billy Goats Gruff', the goats have to get past the troll under the bridge.

clues.wordBConnection: Fairy-tale trolls are famously gruff
clues.revealExplanation: The goats are named Gruff, and the troll they outsmart is pretty gruff too.

clues.wordAConnection: The kiwi is a bird that cannot fly
clues.wordBConnection: Penguins swim instead of flying
clues.revealExplanation: Kiwis and penguins are both birds that can't fly.

clues.wordAConnection: A penguin's black-and-white feathers look like a tuxedo
clues.wordBConnection: Waiters at fancy restaurants often wear tuxedos
clues.revealExplanation: Penguins always look dressed for dinner, just like a waiter in a tux.

clues.wordBConnection: A skeleton crew is the bare minimum staff
clues.revealExplanation: Every ship needs a crew, and a skeleton crew is the smallest one that can run it.

clues.wordBConnection: Reptiles are covered in scales
clues.revealExplanation: Pianists practice their scales; reptiles just wear them.

clues.wordAConnection: The Amazon Echo is a smart speaker
clues.wordBConnection: Bats find their way using echoes (echolocation)
clues.revealExplanation: Amazon sells the Echo, and bats navigate by listening to echoes.

clues.wordAConnection: A white dwarf is a kind of star (and Snow White had seven dwarfs)
clues.wordBConnection: Snow White, and snow is white
clues.revealExplanation: Snow White lived with seven dwarfs, and a white dwarf is a star in space.

clues.wordBConnection: Snowstorm
clues.revealExplanation: Sandstorms in the desert, snowstorms in winter: both are storms.

clues.wordAConnection: A rooster is the classic figure on top of a weather vane
clues.wordBConnection: A weather vane shows which way the wind blows
clues.revealExplanation: The classic weather vane has a rooster perched on top.

clues.wordBConnection: Saturn is famous for its rings
clues.revealExplanation: Boxers step into the ring; Saturn wears a whole set of them.

clues.wordBConnection: Bees turn that nectar into honey
clues.revealExplanation: Bees visit flowers for nectar and turn it into honey.

clues.wordAConnection: A flower starts as a bud
clues.wordBConnection: Taste buds on your tongue
clues.revealExplanation: Flowers grow from buds, and you taste with buds too.

clues.wordAConnection: The dove is pictured carrying an olive branch
clues.wordBConnection: The dove is a symbol of peace
clues.revealExplanation: A dove holding an olive branch is the classic symbol of peace.

clues.wordBConnection: Offering an olive branch means making peace
clues.revealExplanation: Holding out an olive branch is how you offer peace.

clues.wordAConnection: Venus is the second planet from the Sun
clues.wordBConnection: The Venus flytrap is a meat-eating plant
clues.revealExplanation: Venus is a planet, and the Venus flytrap is a plant that snaps up bugs.

clues.wordBConnection: Smokey is the U.S. Forest Service's mascot
clues.revealExplanation: Smokey Bear has spent decades reminding us to prevent forest fires.

clues.wordAConnection: The paper crane is the classic origami model
clues.wordBConnection: Origami is the art of folding paper
clues.revealExplanation: Fold a sheet of paper the right way and you get origami's famous crane.

clues.wordBConnection: Your closet is full of hangers
clues.revealExplanation: Closets are full of hangers, and a cliffhanger leaves you hanging until next time.

clues.wordBConnection: The Stone Age
clues.revealExplanation: The Ice Age and the Stone Age: two famous ages from long, long ago.

clues.wordAConnection: Iceberg lettuce is a salad staple
clues.wordBConnection: The Titanic sank after hitting an iceberg
clues.revealExplanation: An iceberg sank the Titanic, and iceberg lettuce sinks into your salad.

clues.wordAConnection: Shake a bottle of soda and it erupts when opened
clues.wordBConnection: Volcanoes erupt
clues.revealExplanation: Open a shaken soda and you get your own mini eruption.

clues.wordBConnection: Chocolate chip cookies
clues.revealExplanation: A computer chip and a chocolate chip: only one of them tastes good.

clues.wordBConnection: Sounds like taking a bite of a cookie
clues.revealExplanation: Computers count in bytes; cookies disappear one bite at a time.

clues.wordBConnection: Sundae sounds just like Sunday
clues.revealExplanation: A sundae is ice cream with toppings, and it sounds just like Sunday.

clues.wordBConnection: Swiss cheese, the one with holes
clues.revealExplanation: Switzerland gave us both the Swiss Alps and Swiss cheese.

clues.wordBConnection: Crickets chirp by rubbing their wings together
clues.revealExplanation: Birds chirp with their voices; crickets chirp with their wings.
